newsitem.title: USA: Owens & Minor adopts new management equity program.
newsitem.headline: Owens & Minor adopts new management equity program.

text.p: Owens & Minor Inc said Tuesday it had adopted a new equity program for its senior officials, obliging them to gradually increase their share ownership in the company.
It said the Management Equity Ownership Program, which become effective immediately, will require each of its 17 officers to own specified amounts of common stock.
The ownership requirements will gradually increase over five years to a multiple of annual base pay that ranges from one to four times for each grouping of officers, it said.

"We expect to further drive performance by requiring our officers to assume certain personal financial risks," it said, adding that it already had a stock option plan for its officers and a variable pay program based on financial performance.
Based in in Richmond, Virginia, Owens & Minor distributes national branded medical and surgical supplies.
